name: GoalJarFill
job: Show progress to a sales, donation or booking goal as a glass jar filling with liquid whose surface sloshes, with the raised amount and goal printed on the glass
visitor_action: none; moving the pointer across the jar sloshes the liquid, a tap makes a ripple, Enter swirls it when focused
mobile: jar centred, slosh on device tilt is skipped, tap makes a ripple
motion: liquid rises to its level with eased fill and a counting amount while a canvas wave rolls on the surface, then settles and stops (reduced-motion: filled jar, flat surface)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: percent marker overlapped the goal text, moved into the printed stack; shorter fill)

art_direction: Pantry jar: warm kraft-paper background, thick clear glass with a curved highlight, honey-amber liquid, chalk-white label print
